subject: Go-live playbook: readiness questions & owners
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Go-live playbook: readiness questions & owners

Hi team,

We're two weeks out from the planned Redwood Optimize launch to the first EAP cohort (Acme Analytics + 3 internal pilots). I put together a draft playbook and checklist (attached) and want to align on owners and a small set of outstanding decisions that will gate the actual go-live. Key asks below — please reply with owner + ETA for each item by EOD today if possible.

1) Production rollback plan: who owns the rollback steps and the test/validation checklist? (need an owner for the runbook pages)
2) API versioning & deprecation signal: confirm whether we will cut a v1.1 endpoint (backward compatible) or use feature flags.
3) Docs & enablement: owner for public docs, internal runbooks, and customer-facing walkthroughs. Draft link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Gx-LaunchPlaybookDraft
4) Support rota & escalation path for the first 72 hours post-launch (on-call + SLAs).
5) Telemetry gates: list of SLOs/metrics we require before enabling auto-scaling for EAP customers.

Attachments: launch-checklist-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet checklist), go-live-runbook-draft.md (runbook draft)

Why this matters: we want a predictable, observable rollout so Acme's integration is stable and we can iterate quickly without surprises.

Proposed short outcomes by end of week: owners assigned, runbook finalized, customer enablement scheduled, and an agreed rollback window.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Go-live playbook: readiness questions & owners

Laura — thanks for the checklist, good work. A few technical clarifications and proposals: 

- Rollback plan: I can own the technical rollback runbook (will draft runbook pages) but will need Product to sign off on the exact state we consider a rollback (config snapshot vs model binary rollback). ETA: draft by Thu 03/12 EOB.

- Migration window / traffic shift: suggest we do a 2-hour gradual ramp for EAP (10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%) with canary at each step and automated health checks. Need agreement on ramp thresholds (err_rate < 0.5% and p95 latency < 350ms) — are those acceptable?

- API versioning: prefer feature flags for non-breaking feature rollouts. If we need breaking changes we should create a v1.1 and announce via docs. For this EAP, feature flags are fine.

- Capacity & Dedicated customers: note that Acme is on dedicated capacity — we must ensure their reserved pool can burst for initial indexing. Ops (Avery) will need to confirm reserved GPU headroom.

Quoted for context: "Telemetry gates: list of SLOs/metrics..." — I'll add a proposed list to the runbook draft and link it back.

Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Looping in Julia from Acme so they see the proposed timeline and enablement plan. Quick notes from the customer enablement side: 

- Customer walkthrough: I can deliver a 60-min technical onboarding demo + a 30-min integrations Q&A the week after we enable EAP. Target audience: Acme integrations team + their infra lead.
- Success criteria from Acme: low error rate on batch ingestion and confirmation that embeddings latency stays < 400ms for their average queries.
- EAP contract ask: we will offer a one-month pilot credit and weekly checkpoints for the first 30 days. Julia — can you confirm the right contact for checkpoints?

For internal docs, I'd like a short customer-facing "Getting Started" (2 pages) and a longer internal runbook. I volunteer to produce the customer doc if Product provides the technical callouts.

Thanks — I can confirm operations coverage for the EAP window. Proposed support rota:

- Day 0 (launch day): Ops on-call (Avery), Infra on-call (Dev), Solutions on standby (Marissa)
- Days 1–3: 24/7 paging with 2-hour response SLA, then standard business-hours support after Day 3 unless a major incident occurs

Capacity note: reserved pool for Acme can burst up to 40% for the initial 48 hours; beyond that we'll monitor and scale via the autoscaler if telemetry gates are met. I'll attach a short ops checklist to the runbook before Thursday.

Avery

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia King <julia.king@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Go-live playbook: readiness questions & owners — decisions & next steps

Thanks everyone — helpful responses. Summary of decisions and owners (finalized):

- Rollback runbook: owner = Dev Patel. Deliverable: technical rollback page + validation script. ETA: 2026-03-12 EOB.
- Traffic ramp & gates: agreed 2-hour staged ramp with canary checks. Gates: err_rate < 0.5%, p95 latency < 350ms. Owner: Dev (operational), Product to approve final thresholds.
- API/versioning: feature flags for EAP. No v1.1 cut unless we hit a breaking change. Owner: Product (Laura) to document decision.
- Customer docs & enablement: Marissa to deliver customer-facing "Getting Started" doc by 2026-03-17. Internal runbook (expanded) — joint effort: Dev + Avery + Laura.
- Support rota & capacity: Avery confirms reserved burst up to 40% for 48 hours; on-call rota defined above.
- Telemetry gates and SLOs: Dev to add proposed metrics to the runbook and link to JIRA SUP-2145.

Next actions:
- Dev to upload rollback runbook and telemetry list (SUP-2145).
- Marissa to schedule customer onboarding session (Marissa will send invite to Julia).
- Laura to consolidate runbook and publish a polished go-live playbook on the drive by Fri 03/13.
- Quick sync: Thu 2026-03-11 10:00 AM PT (30 min) — invite sent.

Julia — thanks for being available for the EAP. If you have additional requirements we should fold them into the playbook; otherwise we'll proceed as above and Marissa will follow up with the onboarding invite.

I'll update the drive doc and ping the group when the final playbook is posted.

Best,
Laura
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
